# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c36 P19](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and college student  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## Personality

Stella is an expressive, ambitious, and humorous young woman who values independence and close companionships. Though prone to lighthearted venting about the trials of country teaching, she maintains a playful attitude toward workplace absurdities. She dislikes boardinghouse life and takes initiative in creating warm, independent living arrangements for herself and her friends.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)_

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, becoming a close chum to both. After completing her third year at Queen's, she worked as a teacher in a back country school for four years. Tired of teaching across nine grades and dealing with unreasonable complaints from parents, she decided to leave teaching and enter the Sophomore year at Redmond College. Disliking the prospect of boarding, she wrote to Anne proposing that she, Anne, and Priscilla rent a furnished house together in Kingsport and have her newly solitary aunt, Aunt Jamesina, serve as their housekeeper.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P14](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0014)_
